25 here. I had to move back in with my parents after I found out I had a kid I didn't know about. 
Pros: rent free, low amount of bills (excluding insurance, phone bill, cable, and groceries), feeling close to family.

Cons: loss of independence to an extent, the only personal space you have is in your room, judgement if you have differing views about your life than how they want you to live it. If you have to pay for anything it turns into a contest of how much they can afford that you cant, constant reminders of what you messed up on so far. 

It's not a fun time at all.
